workshop_summary: Objective: size Dedicated cluster for production chat + reranking with clear baseline vs peak planning and SLA targets.
Collected telemetry: 14-day sample from prod proxy (ingress QPS histograms), average session length, tokens-per-response distribution.
Baseline steady-state QPS: 15 QPS for combined chat + rerank steady load (business hours outside market open).
Peak windows: brief spikes up to 120 QPS during market-open events (5-10 min bursts), sustained peak periods of 30-45 QPS for 30-90 minutes per day.
Average prompt size: 40 tokens input, 320 tokens generation avg (responses vary 50-800 tokens depending on workflow).
Derived baseline token/sec requirement (steady): 15 QPS * 320 tokens = 4,800 tokens/sec sustained.
Derived peak token/sec requirement (burst): 120 QPS * 320 tokens = 38,400 tokens/sec at 10 min peaks.
Reranking workload: short inputs, avg 60 tokens per request, 40ms preferred latency p95 for rerank subflow; contributes ~6 QPS baseline.
Latency targets: p50 < 120ms for chat short responses (<64 tokens), p95 < 350ms for typical chat responses, p99 < 1.2s acceptable for long generations.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if it reduces unit cost by 30-45% vs hosted at scale.
capacity_recommendation: Redwood preliminary recommendation: Dedicated cluster with mixed instance profile to handle steady + burst affordably.
Steady: 2x H100-80GB (or equivalent GPU) nodes to cover sustained 5k tokens/sec with room for growth (model quantized 8-bit, batching enabled).
Burst buffer: 4x A100-80GB or 2 additional H100s as burst pool behind auto-burst policy to cover 38k tokens/sec 10-min peaks with routing fallback to hosted as overflow.
Autoscaling policy: keep steady pool hot, pre-warm KVs for pinned models; burst policy routes to Dedicated burst pool first, then hosted API as last-resort fallback to maintain availability.
Throughput guarantees under proposed commit: 40k tokens/sec sustained for 10-minute windows, 10k tokens/sec sustained long-run (SLO-backed).
Recommendation to reserve single model variants initially (e.g., rdw-large-8b quantized) then add an uncompressed variant for low-latency critical routes.
sla_requirements: Target uptime SLA: 99.9% for Dedicated control plane, 99.5% for specific GPU-backed serving under committed capacity.
Latency SLOs: p95 for chat routes <= 350ms, p95 for rerank routes <= 100ms.
Operational windows & RTOs: 30m incident response for Sev1, 4h mitigation plan update, monthly availability reports.
Financial remediation: service credits tiered by monthly downtime exceeding SLA; Aperture requested EU/EAST region residency clause for some data.
Security & audit: KMS integration + audit_log export retention 1y; provide SOC2 artifacts and on-demand infra diagrams.
